description: React component for displaying and printing billing history, including fetching data from API, rendering billing records, and generating printable HTML report.

methods.name: fetchHistory
methods.description: Fetches billing history data from API and updates state.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Clears billing history via API call.

methods.name: handlePrint
methods.description: Generates and opens a printable HTML report of billing history for selected date.
